chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever recites the Chapter four times, it is as if he has recited the entire Qur'an.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Al-Inshirah four times?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* emphasizes the spiritual potency of reciting Surah Al-Kafirah (or Al-Ikhlas, depending on the specific manuscript tradition) four times, equating it to the reward of the entire Qur'an. In Shia scholarly tradition, this highlights the concept of *thawab* (reward) multiplication through specific devotional acts, reinforcing the centrality of Tawhid (monotheism) as the core essence of the Qur'anic message.
